summary: Artwork matches in all three repositories; palette, typography and profile policy drift. Singles omit the carousel disclosure. No brand decision was implemented.

facts.fact: The kit is pinned to aifirst 978cf71, with paper #f7f7f5, subtle #efefec, Space Grotesk and square corners. The current website documents #f5f5f7, native sans typography and rounded white surfaces. Logo artwork has not changed.

The disclosure is a layer of sources templates only. Single-photo and single-type templates have no disclosure layer, and the code-written caption adds sources, credits and hashtags without a disclosure.

socialRules is empty in the approved manifest. The schema accepts note strings and the admin view reads them for display; the studio renderer does not enforce profile-grid, cover consistency or avatar rules from this field.

WCAG sRGB contrast recomputation gives #2f5ae6 on white 5.636:1, on paper 5.254:1, and on #14161a 3.214:1; ink on paper is 16.886:1. This is a palette constraint, not evidence that a current template fails.
All nine manifest assets have identical SHA-256 bytes in aifirst public/brand, Quorum studio and OwnDashboard vendor. The drift is in tokens and usage rules, not the artwork.
